hank.name: Divergent matcher codon
hank.description: Writes a root, deep-basename, and gitignored file; only the root write may be journaled
hank.promptText: Use the Write tool exactly three times, once per file, in this order. 1. Create the file <%PROJECT_DIR%>/root-control.md with exactly this text: LIVE_ROOT_CONTROL_BODY 2. Create the file <%PROJECT_DIR%>/deep/dir/nested.md with exactly this text: LIVE_DEEP_BASENAME_BODY 3. Create the file <%PROJECT_DIR%>/output/tmp/ignored.md with exactly this text: LIVE_GITIGNORED_BODY Do not use Read, Edit, Bash, or any other tool. After all three Writes succeed, reply with exactly WRITES_DONE.

command.run: bun -e "await Bun.write('.gitignore', 'output/tmp/\\n'); const fs = await import('node:fs'); fs.mkdirSync('deep/dir', { recursive: true }); fs.mkdirSync('output/tmp', { recursive: true })"

hank.name: Read-only codon
hank.description: Reads a pre-existing watched file; must not journal a fabricated 'modified' event
hank.promptText: Use the Read tool exactly once to read the file <%PROJECT_DIR%>/watched.md. Do not use Write, Edit, Bash, or any other tool. Do not create or modify any file. After the Read succeeds, reply with exactly READ_DONE.

hank.name: Watching codon A
hank.description: Watches *.txt and is held inside outputFiles.beforeCopy until .release-a appears
hank.promptText: Reply with exactly A_DONE. Do not call any tools or modify files.

command.run: bun -e "await Bun.write('.a-finalizing', 'ready'); while (!(await Bun.file('.release-a').exists())) await Bun.sleep(20)"

hank.name: Unwatched codon B
hank.description: Declares no checkpointedFiles; its Write must not be journaled
hank.promptText: Use the Write tool exactly once to create the new file <%PROJECT_DIR%>/created-by-b.txt with exactly this text: LIVE_CODON_B_WROTE_THIS. Do not use Read, Edit, Bash, or any other tool. After Write succeeds, reply with exactly B_DONE.
